---------------------------------- **LIMITED ACCESS** -----------------------------

**(Opens only on weekends)**

You're a tiny bear. This is a fairy tale. Nothing is safe or normal.

Step into storybook worlds as a mischievous little beast on a mission: swallow every magical tink you can find, outrun your rivals, and flush yourself to glory. This is Fabula — free to play on all Meta Quest devices.


# 🍄 EAT THE LOOT

Forget backpacks. You swallow everything. Stuff yourself full, sprint for the toilet, and flush it all into Fame. 



# 🚽 EXTRACT THROUGH A TOILET

The only way out is down. Find an extraction toilet, flush yourself through, and everything in your belly converts into Fame. Stay greedy too long and you won't make it.


# ⚔️ YOUR FRIENDS... OR ENEMIES

Form a party, raid together, share the chaos — or stab each other in the back over a legendary artifact. Up to 10 players, one world, no guarantees. Boss fights, rival parties, and the occasional exploding chicken stand between you and glory.


# ✨ BUILD A LEGEND

Raid storybook worlds, steal from bosses, collect Fame points, betray your friends. The story was never about the heroes anyway.
